scope: every file under fetch/*/ except receipts.jsonl; quote-check.json is a derived analysis artifact, not a fetched body
apply: L1: commit only entries with retain=commit after their receipts and LICENSE bodies are present; keep digest-only bodies out of git (gitignore by path) and never delete them; receipts.jsonl stay committed for every entry

rule_refs.commit: Sentinel C1 (tag/commit-pinned raw or api.github.com metadata, text, <=1 MiB, byte-stable, OSI licence) + C2 (LICENSE fetched per repo/ref) + C3 (gitleaks clean over the commit subset)
rule_refs.digest_only: D1 (text/html or per-request tokens), D2 (no redistribution grant: unlicensed/UGC/GFDL/AUR/docs sites), D3 (binary archives), N3 (agent-file names), F6 (no receipt line)
